name: Naos-01: The Quiet Sector
storyline: Trapped behind enemy lines and with the Naos scientific-military base in chaos, Helios manages to evade capture. Without reinforcements and surrounded by hostile patrols, they must advance silently, hiding in the shadows and waiting for the perfect moment to move. Their only option is to infiltrate occupied areas and send a distress signal to their allies before Naos falls completely.
summary: Trapped behind enemy lines as the Naos scientific-military base descends into chaos, Helios evades capture without reinforcements. Surrounded by hostile patrols, they must move silently through the shadows, infiltrate occupied zones, and send a distress signal before Naos falls completely.
